summaryOfDefects.description: invoke('scan_local_vault') throws outside Tauri (or when vault fails to load), setting loading=false while data remains null. Because line 241 checks (loading || !data), the UI stays permanently trapped on 'Scanning local prompt history…' with zero interactive recovery, sample data fallback, or onboarding import CTA.

Sidebar displays '420 pts' alongside 'Compounding across 0 active career commitments' even when data is null or empty. Additionally, Mirror tab hardcodes '7 PM – 12 AM' and '40% of all architectural & lab prompts' (lines 281-282) and Vault tab hardcodes 'Notice your two distinct peaks: 10 AM–1 PM (Execution) and 7 PM–Midnight (Deep Architecture Lab)' (line 552) regardless of actual user prompt distribution.

Navigation tabs lack role='tablist' (or aria-label on nav), buttons lack role='tab', aria-selected, and aria-controls, and main content lacks role='tabpanel' and aria-live status announcements during scanning.

Zero :focus-visible styles exist anywhere in styles.css. Furthermore, --text-muted (#76827c) fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 normal text contrast on --bg-warm (#faf7f2, ratio 3.55:1), --bg-card (#ffffff, ratio 3.85:1), and sidebar (#f4efe6, ratio 3.32:1); --accent-gold (#b8862d) on --bg-amber-soft (#fdf3e7) also fails WCAG AA at 2.91:1.

Zero responsive @media queries in styles.css (.stats-grid and .meter-row are rigid 4-column grids that squeeze cards at 1024x768). Entire application is a 600-line monolithic App.tsx with extensive inline styles.
